name: dmnktoe/wp-mobile-de-sync
description: Synchronises a dealer's vehicle inventory from mobile.de into the vehicles custom post type.
comment: Composer is only needed for the development tooling: the coding standards, and league/commonmark for the project site (bin/build-site.php). The plugin itself has no runtime dependencies and runs without a vendor/ directory, which is why vendor/ is not part of the release package.
